note: Three hand-authored personas for the RLSS UK NPLQ / ILSF Lifeguard Competency Verification grader. gradeLifeguard evaluates all 46 declarative rules and returns { outcome, criticalFailures, deficiencies, firedRules, answeredCount, totalRules }: firedRules always lists every rule (in registry order, steps 2-9) with its tri-state status; answeredCount counts only 'yes'/'no' ('na' and '' are excluded); any critical rule at 'no' -> 'fail'; otherwise 0 non-critical 'no' -> 'pass', and ANY number of non-critical 'no' -> 'needs-development' (the >2 branch is written separately but yields the same outcome); answeredCount 0 -> 'fail' (an unmarked sheet fails rather than passing vacuously). Two rules fall back to numeric measurements when their explicit tri-state is blank: LIFE-PF-50M-TIME from swim50mTimeSeconds (<= 60 s) and LIFE-CPR-COMPRESSIONS from compressionRate (100-120/min) AND compressionDepth (5.0-6.0 cm) - an explicit 'yes'/'no' always wins over the measurement. detectAdditionalFlags (flagged-issues.js) is a separate export taking the grading result and depending on Date.now() for the expired-certification flag, so flags are pinned here through flagsHint/flagsArgs (the Phase 13 tooling item, done 2026-09-03); each description records the flags the persona would raise. No timestamp is returned by gradeLifeguard. Regenerate 'expected' with: bin/test-personas lifeguard-certification-checklist --update Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.additionalFlags via flagsHint "detectAdditionalFlags" with flagsArgs ["state","result"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectAdditionalFlags(state, grading); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: Clean pass - initial NPLQ candidate, every competency demonstrated
personas.description: Nineteen-year-old initial candidate at a leisure-centre pool. Every one of the 46 rules is 'yes'; the timed swim (52 s) and CPR compressions (110/min, 5.5 cm) are left to the numeric fallback so the derived path is exercised. Expect outcome 'pass', criticalFailures [], deficiencies [], answeredCount 46, totalRules 46, and all 46 firedRules with status 'yes'. Unpinned flags: only the three low-priority debrief flags (examiner notes, candidate feedback, development areas all recorded); no prior certification so no expiry check.

overallResultSignoff.strengths: Calm, decisive rescues; excellent scanning discipline; textbook spinal handling.
overallResultSignoff.developmentAreas: Keep refining AED pad placement speed.
overallResultSignoff.examinerNotes: Strong candidate; recommend as a role model for the next cohort.
overallResultSignoff.candidateFeedback: Felt well prepared; found the spinal station the hardest.

personas.name: Needs development - requalifying beach lifeguard with two knowledge gaps
personas.description: Non-critical edge case: an experienced beach lifeguard requalifying (prior certificate valid to 2027). Every critical competency is demonstrated; two non-critical rules are 'no' (burns management LIFE-FA-BURNS and RIDDOR awareness LIFE-LR-RIDDOR - different categories, so no domain-weakness flag), and two items were not assessed as 'na' (LIFE-SP-ROLL, no face-down roll indicated; LIFE-FA-OXYGEN, no oxygen kit at the beach venue). The timed swim is 58 s (within target, but inside the 5-second margin) and compressions are 118/min at exactly 5.0 cm, both via the numeric fallback. Expect outcome 'needs-development', criticalFailures [], deficiencies [LIFE-FA-BURNS, LIFE-LR-RIDDOR], answeredCount 44, totalRules 46. Unpinned flags: FLAG-MULTI-DEF (medium, exactly 2 deficiencies), FLAG-SWIM-50M-MARGIN (medium), plus low debrief flags; no expiry flag (2027 is in the future).

overallResultSignoff.strengths: Outstanding surf rescues and casualty handling; confident team leadership.
overallResultSignoff.developmentAreas: Burns first aid (cooling duration, no ointments); RIDDOR reportable-event categories.
overallResultSignoff.examinerNotes: Two knowledge gaps only - re-present the first-aid theory and RIDDOR module within 4 weeks.

deficiencies.description: Manages burns appropriately (cool water, cover, do not break blisters).
Demonstrates awareness of RIDDOR reportable events.

personas.name: Fail - lapsed requalifier, three critical failures, assessment halted after CPR
personas.description: Critical-highest persona: a requalifying pool lifeguard whose certificate expired 2026-01-31, assessed 2026-03-07. Three critical competencies fail: the timed swim measures 66 s with the tri-state left blank (numeric fallback -> 'no'), the unconscious-casualty tow (LIFE-RU-TOW) is 'no', and compressions measure 90/min at 4.2 cm with the tri-state blank (both out of range -> 'no'). Four non-critical rules are 'no' (LIFE-PF-TOW, LIFE-RU-AIRWAY, LIFE-RU-HANDOVER, LIFE-CPR-QUALITY), LIFE-SP-ROLL is 'na', and the examiner halted the session after the CPR station so all twelve first-aid and legal items are '' (unanswered). Expect outcome 'fail', criticalFailures in registry order [LIFE-PF-50M-TIME, LIFE-RU-TOW, LIFE-CPR-COMPRESSIONS], deficiencies [LIFE-PF-TOW, LIFE-RU-AIRWAY, LIFE-RU-HANDOVER, LIFE-CPR-QUALITY], answeredCount 33 (46 - 12 unanswered - 1 na), totalRules 46. Unpinned flags would be extensive: high FLAG-CRIT-LIFE-PF-50M-TIME, FLAG-CRIT-LIFE-RU-TOW, FLAG-CRIT-LIFE-CPR-COMPRESSIONS, FLAG-CERT-EXPIRED (wall-clock: true on any run after 2026-01-31), FLAG-DOMAIN-UNCONSCIOUS-RESCUE (two deficiencies in one category), FLAG-MULTI-DEF (4 > 3 -> high), FLAG-SWIM-50M-SLOW; medium FLAG-CPR-RATE-RANGE, FLAG-CPR-DEPTH-RANGE, FLAG-CPR-HESITATE-DEPTH, FLAG-AED-SLOW (112 s); low FLAG-DEBRIEF-EXAMINER, FLAG-DEVELOPMENT-AREAS.

overallResultSignoff.strengths: Scanning and conscious-casualty rescue remain sound.
overallResultSignoff.developmentAreas: Swim fitness (50 m and tow), unconscious-casualty airway and tow technique, CPR rate and depth, AED retrieval time.
overallResultSignoff.examinerNotes: Assessment stopped after the CPR/AED station on safety grounds. Candidate has not worked poolside since certificate lapsed; advise a structured 6-week fitness and skills programme before re-presenting.
